created: The reviewed target digests and AI-reviewed label identity match the supplied draft, one mutation succeeds, and live title, body, labels, state and URL match exactly.
refresh_review: The supplied repo, title or body differs from the current reviewed target digest, or its labels differ from the review-time label identity, before provider access.
blocked: The provider result cannot be parsed, differs from the reviewed draft, or recovery finds zero or multiple exact matches.
